answer:
Final Response:

Course found: 'Sustainable Agricultural Land Management' offered by the University of Florida on Coursera (https://www.coursera.org/learn/sustainable-agriculture).

Course objectives:
- Skills you'll gain: Environmental Issue, Water Quality, Water Resources, Environmental Regulations, Water Resource Management, Land Management.
- About this course: This course will cover the agricultural and urban water quality issues in Florida, their bases, land and nutrient management strategies, and the science and policy behind the best management practices (BMPs). Students will learn to evaluate BMP research and analyze its role in determining practices and policies that protect water quality.

Lead instructor background:
George J. Hochmuth, Ph.D. — Professor, University of Florida. Instructor rating: 4.8 (244 ratings); 1 Course • 59,245 learners. He leads the Research Program in Urban and Agricultural Fertilization and Nutrient Management Practices. His research focuses on water quality and nutrient and water management in urban and agricultural settings, including nitrogen and phosphorus management, best management practices (BMPs), and the science behind policies that protect water quality.
